title: Palace in war of words with Earl Spencer over claims in Diana book
description: The row threatens to overshadow a very crowded day for the royals - with the King and Princes William and Harry all attending events.

title: Tech treating AI like humans is mistaken and misguided, Microsoft boss tells BBC

title: New hope for breast cancer patients as life-extending drug now on NHS in England
description: Enhertu, which can give patients an extra seven months to live on average, has been prescribed in Scotland for more than two years and is available.

title: Assad regime planned US journalist Austin Tice's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
description: Austin Tice’s abduction was approved by Syria’s former leader Bashar al-Assad, a source claims.

title: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods

title: Ed Sheeran asked me to donate $2m in aid, Robert Kraft says after Macklemore backlash
description: It comes after Macklemore pledged $1m to Palestinian causes, challenging the tycoon to match the sum.

title: Lena Dunham announces birth of first baby via surrogacy
description: The writer and actress announced the birth of her daughter in an op-ed published by Vogue on Wednesday.

title: Bank of England expected to hold interest rates as it faces tough choices
description: Forecasts of further rises in the inflation rate mean some analysts expect the Bank to act by the end of the year.

title: At least seven months of relentless rain needed to end drought, research shows
description: Almost 75% of England remains in drought following an exceptionally dry spring and summer.
